description: This file declares functions for token parsing related to AT commands in the Android RIL (Radio Interface Layer). It provides function prototypes for starting token parsing, extracting integers, hex integers, booleans, strings, checking for more tokens, and skipping commas.

methods.name: at_tok_start
methods.description: Initializes token parsing from the current position.

methods.name: at_tok_nextint
methods.description: Parses the next token as an integer.

methods.name: at_tok_nexthexint
methods.description: Parses the next token as a hexadecimal integer.

methods.name: at_tok_nextbool
methods.description: Parses the next token as a boolean value.

methods.name: at_tok_nextstr
methods.description: Parses the next token as a string.

methods.name: at_tok_hasmore
methods.description: Checks if there are more tokens to parse.

methods.name: skipNextComma
methods.description: Skips the next comma in the token stream.
